essence: The moon-lord and Venus are presented as supreme exemplars in their spheres.
Elemental forces and Shiva are identified as supreme in purity, rulership, and guidance.
Primordial sound, Gauri, Shri, and Narada are presented as supreme in their respective domains.
Pavana and Varuna hold supreme lordship over wind and water creatures respectively.
Food, Sudarshana, and the thunderbolt are identified as supreme in their respective domains.
